reply: [{"query": "根据GVP Module VI Addendum I，如果上市许可持有人未按规定与EMA或成员国主管当局协作检测重复病例报告，会受到何种处罚或制裁？", "query_en": "According to GVP Module VI Addendum I, what penalties or sanctions apply if a marketing authorisation holder fails to collaborate with the Agency or Member State competent authorities in detecting duplicate suspected adverse reaction reports?", "topic": "重复病例协作失职的处罚", "absence_terms": ["penalty", "sanction", "infringement", "non-compliance"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 3, "text": "Marketing authorisation holders shall collaborate with the Agency and the Member States in the detection of duplicates of suspected adverse reaction reports"}, "rationale": "文档引用了Directive 2001/83/EC中关于重复病例检测协作义务的条款，但通篇未规定不履行该协作义务时应承担的处罚或制裁措施。"}, {"query": "根据本附录，已确认为重复病例的记录（包括从属重复病例文件）应保留多长时间？", "query_en": "According to this Addendum, how long should records of confirmed duplicate cases, including subordinate duplicate case files, be retained?", "topic": "重复病例记录保留期限", "absence_terms": ["retention period", "retain", "years", "archiving"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 10, "text": "All subordinate duplicate cases and related ICSRs should be retained and there should be adequate cross-referencing between case files and/or database entries."}, "rationale": "文档多处要求保留从属重复病例及其ICSR以备审计追踪，但从未说明具体应保留的年限或期限。"}]
